locale.description: Optional instance language override. Otherwise use the interaction or server locale.

panelChannel.description: Managed channel key where /verify-panel posts the button.

verifiedRole.description: Managed role granting access after verification.

method.description: Preferred challenge method. typed (default): type a 6-character code shown in an image; visual: pick a 4-digit number among 12. Both need the optional render grant.

fallback.description: When a typed or visual challenge cannot be served (no render grant, or rendering fails): review sends the member to the staff queue; button offers the one-click button. Both set an instance status line.

minAccountAgeDays.description: Minimum age of the Discord account in days.

youngAccount.description: Policy for a successful challenge from a young account.

delayHours.description: Hours before a delayed member may try again.

kickAfterHours.description: Hours before pending accounts expire; zero disables expiration kicks.

dmOnJoin.description: Send the member a personal link when direct messages are granted.

turnstileSiteKey.description: Public Turnstile site key loaded by the portal widget.

hcaptchaSiteKey.description: Public hCaptcha site key loaded by the portal widget.

returnInvite.description: Optional server invitation shown only to its verified recovery-link subject after the allowed return time.
